descripcion: Anionic surfactant with high detergent and foaming power, the base of most liquid and powder detergents on the market. It is neutralized with caustic soda or other bases to form the active sulfonate in the formula. It is the reference raw material for dishwashing liquids, multi-purpose detergents, and degreasers for household and institutional use.
formas_referenciales: Viscous liquid — amber tone that varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Versatile anionic surfactant, valued for its foaming capacity and its compatibility with other surfactants. It responds well to salt thickening, which makes it easy to formulate products with attractive viscosity at low cost. Used in dishwashing liquids, liquid soaps, shampoos, and multi-purpose cleaners.
formas_referenciales: Paste or viscous liquid, depending on the grade and manufacturer

descripcion: Anionic surfactant with abundant, fast-generating foam, with good wetting and detergent power in aqueous systems. It complements sodium laureth sulfate in formulas that require greater foam volume. Common in powder detergents, cleaning pastes, and foaming products.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or needles, depending on the manufacturer and batch
Liquid — aqueous solution, depending on availability

descripcion: Amphoteric surfactant that boosts and stabilizes the foam of anionic systems and adds viscosity to the formula. It stands out for its compatibility with quaternary ammonium compounds, which makes it common in disinfectant cleaners. Used in dishwashing liquids, foaming cleaners, and cleaning products with cationic biocides.
formas_referenciales: Aqueous liquid — clear to slightly cloudy, depending on the batch

descripcion: Nonionic surfactant with excellent wetting and degreasing power and low sensitivity to hard water. It is the base of industrial degreasers and liquid detergents aimed at greasy soils. Its nonionic character makes it easy to combine with anionic and cationic surfactants in the same formula.
formas_referenciales: Liquid to paste, depending on the degree of ethoxylation, manufacturer, and temperature

descripcion: Classic thickener and foam stabilizer for anionic surfactant systems. It adds body and superfatting to liquid detergents and dishwashing liquids, and helps maintain foam in the presence of greasy soil. A traditional raw material in the cleaning and personal care industry.
formas_referenciales: Viscous liquid — amber tone that varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Nonionic surfactant derived from glucose and fatty alcohols, with a good biodegradability profile. It provides wetting and detergency with low harshness and is stable in strongly alkaline media. Used in cleaners with an eco-friendly positioning, alkaline degreasers, and personal care formulas.
formas_referenciales: Viscous liquid — yellow to amber tone depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Anionic surfactant with good detergency and stable foam even in hard water. It works as an alternative or complement to linear sulfonate in powder and liquid detergents. Also used in economy shampoos and foaming cleaning products.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — aqueous solution, depending on the manufacturer's grade
Solid — powder or needles, depending on the presentation and batch

descripcion: Quaternary ammonium compound widely used as an active ingredient in disinfectant and sanitizing formulations for surfaces. It also provides cationic surfactant properties and an antistatic effect in the formula. Its use in disinfection is carried out in accordance with applicable health regulations.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — aqueous solution, depending on the grade and manufacturer

descripcion: Twin-chain quaternary ammonium compound used as a biocidal active in surface disinfectants, alone or blended with benzalkonium chloride. Associated with good performance in the presence of organic matter and hard water. Its use is subject to applicable health regulations.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — solution, depending on the grade and manufacturer

descripcion: Oxidizing agent used as a bleach and as an active ingredient in disinfectant and sanitizing formulations. It decomposes into water and oxygen, which makes it attractive in low-residue formulas. Used in institutional cleaning, laundry, and industrial processes in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — aqueous solution, depending on the available grade

descripcion: Powerful oxidizer used as a sanitizer in the food and beverage industry and in institutional disinfection. It works at low temperatures and degrades into byproducts with low environmental impact. Its handling and dosing are carried out in accordance with applicable regulations and the manufacturer's recommendations.
aplicaciones: CIP sanitization in food and beverage
formas_referenciales: Liquid — equilibrium solution, depending on the grade and manufacturer

descripcion: The most widely used source of active chlorine in household and institutional liquid bleaches and disinfectants. Base raw material for commercial bleaches, chlorinated cleaners, and water treatment applications. The available chlorine content varies with time and storage conditions, so verifying the certificate of analysis (CoA) for each batch is recommended.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — aqueous solution; concentration varies depending on the batch and storage

descripcion: Organic source of stabilized chlorine, valued for its ease of dosing and its good storage stability. It releases active chlorine in a controlled manner when dissolved in water. Used in surface disinfectants, emergency water purification, and institutional sanitization, in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — granules or tablets, depending on the manufacturer's presentation and batch

descripcion: Aldehyde used as a biocidal active in disinfectants for institutional, agro-industrial, and veterinary use. Common in blends with quaternary ammonium compounds to broaden the formula's spectrum of action. Its use is subject to applicable health regulations and the manufacturer's handling recommendations.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — aqueous solution, depending on the manufacturer's grade

descripcion: Isothiazolinone blend used as a broad-spectrum preservative to protect detergents, liquid soaps, and aqueous cleaners throughout their shelf life. Associated with in-container protection against bacteria, fungi, and yeasts at low use levels. Its dosing is carried out in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — clear to slightly yellow, depending on the batch

descripcion: Fundamental alkali of the cleaning industry: it saponifies fats, neutralizes sulfonic acids, and adjusts the pH of all kinds of formulas. It is the base of heavy-duty degreasers, drain openers, and CIP cleaners in the food industry. A high-turnover raw material in soap and detergent manufacturing.
formas_referenciales: Solid — flakes, pearls, or micropearls, depending on the manufacturer and batch
Liquid — aqueous solution, depending on availability

descripcion: Highly soluble alkali used in the manufacture of liquid and potassium soaps, degreasers, and industrial cleaners. It produces soaps that are more soluble and faster to saponify than those made with caustic soda. Also used for pH adjustment in concentrated liquid formulas.
formas_referenciales: Solid — flakes or pearls, depending on the manufacturer and batch
Liquid — aqueous solution, depending on availability

descripcion: Alkaline builder that provides alkalinity, degreasing power, and soil dispersion in powder and liquid detergents. It helps protect sensitive metal surfaces during alkaline cleaning. Used in industrial degreasers, detergents for mechanical dishwashing, and high-pH cleaners.
formas_referenciales: Solid — granules or powder, in pentahydrate or anhydrous grade depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Classic detergency builder: it sequesters water hardness, disperses soil, and helps prevent its redeposition onto fabrics. It boosts surfactant performance in powder detergents, liquid detergents, and institutional cleaners. Its incorporation is subject to local regulations on phosphates.
formas_referenciales: Solid — granules or powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Solid active-oxygen bleach that releases hydrogen peroxide when dissolved in water. It is the base of active-oxygen stain removers, laundry boosters, and detergents with built-in bleach. Active at moderate temperatures, especially in combination with bleach activators.
formas_referenciales: Solid — granules, coated or uncoated depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Inorganic salt used as a filler and flow agent in powder detergents, and as a viscosity regulator in liquid anionic surfactant systems. It adds volume and flowability to the finished product at low cost. A standard raw material in the detergent industry and in textile dyeing.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or granules, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: The reference chelating agent in detergency: it sequesters calcium, magnesium, and transition metals that interfere with surfactants and bleaches. It improves formula performance in hard water and contributes to formula stability. Used in liquid detergents, alkaline cleaners, and institutional products.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or granules, depending on the manufacturer and batch
Liquid — aqueous solution, depending on availability

descripcion: Chelating agent of biotechnological origin with very good performance in strongly alkaline media, where it sequesters calcium and iron. Due to its biodegradability, it is an alternative to phosphates and EDTA in alkaline cleaners. Used in CIP cleaning, high-pH degreasers, and bottle washing.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or granules, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Enzyme that breaks down protein-based stains such as blood, egg, milk, and sweat during laundry washing. It makes it possible to formulate well-performing detergents at low temperatures, reducing the energy consumption of washing. Used in powder detergents, liquid detergents, and enzymatic pre-wash products.
formas_referenciales: Solid — encapsulated granules, depending on the manufacturer and batch
Liquid — enzyme concentrate, depending on availability

descripcion: Cellulose-derived polymer used as an anti-redeposition agent in laundry detergents: it keeps soil suspended in the wash water and helps prevent it from returning to the fabric. It also adds viscosity and stability to liquid formulas. Used in powder detergents, liquid detergents, and laundry soaps.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or granules, depending on the grade and manufacturer

descripcion: Fluorescent whitening agent that absorbs ultraviolet light and re-emits it as visible blue light, improving the perceived whiteness of fabrics. It is a classic component of detergents for white laundry. The type of brightener is selected according to the textile substrate and the washing process.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or granules, depending on the type, manufacturer, and batch

descripcion: Cationic active for fabric softeners, with a more favorable biodegradability profile than that of traditional quaternary compounds. It provides softness, static control, and ease of ironing to fabrics. It is the base of the concentrated and diluted fabric softeners on today's market.
formas_referenciales: Solid — pastilles or flakes, depending on the manufacturer and batch
Paste to viscous liquid depending on the grade and temperature
